---

Binary SHIPPED/NOT STARTED reporting means a booting image with an unverified payload reads as NOT STARTED, and will keep reading that way through most of the work. Visible progress will lag actual progress permanently, and that gap is widest exactly when the boot work is going well.

```day-tension
{"between":["honest-assurance","it-actually-boots"]}
```
